items.title: Why Fervo Energy Stock Surged This Week
items.summary: The company's signing of an agreement with an industry powerhouse led to fervent investor enthusiasm for Fervo stock.

items.title: Nvidia’s Problem: OpenAI Is “90 Plus Percent Nvidia,” and It’s the Lab Burning Cash
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOpenAI’s adjusted operating margin is negative 109%; Anthropic’s is about 15% positive on an adjusted basis. OpenAI runs 90-plus percent on NVIDIA; Anthropic, one third or less, per SemiAnalysis’s Dylan Patel.

items.title: SpaceX caught Starship from orbit with ‘robot chopsticks’ in a world 1st — but lost its booster in the Gulf of Mexico
items.summary: Elon Musk’s company caught its returning Starship in the arms of its Mechazilla launch tower on Nov. 14, but the Super Heavy booster never made it back.

items.title: Elon Musk Warns Nvidia Will Lose ‘Critical Deals’ Without Jensen Huang
items.summary: Some of Nvidia's most important supplier relationships may rest on a handshake, not a contract. Musk says that gap could cost the chipmaker dearly, and one analyst's account of Huang's personal persuasion explains why the timing is so tense.

items.title: Michael Burry Warned AI Chips Would Lose Value Fast. New Data Suggests He Was Wrong
items.summary: Michael Burry says Big Tech is hiding $176 billion in depreciation behind generous server lifespans. A fresh look at what GPU renters are actually paying for older chips puts a stubborn crack in his argument, but it leaves one bigger question open.

items.title: Google to launch drone deliveries in UK
items.summary: Google is planning to launch drone deliveries to households in the UK for the first time in a challenge to Amazon’s rival Prime Air service.

items.title: Why falling AI token prices aren’t the negative for AI providers one might assume
items.summary: Investing.com -- Falling AI token prices need not hurt AI providers because cheaper tokens make more uses worth paying for, Yardeni Research said, pointing to Anthropic’s third-quarter revenue of $16.96 billion, up 47% from the second quarter.

items.title: A $5.9 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $5. 9 billion fund more than tripled its Alphabet stake and added heavily to Danaher and Visa in the quarter ended June 30.
